_comment: Project-level MCP config template — the FIXED server set for the jairus stack (Next.js · Neon · Vercel · GitHub · Stripe). /jairus:ship writes this to the project root as .mcp.json. All servers are remote HTTP + browser OAuth — authorize once with `claude mcp login <server>`; no tokens in this file. Runtime app secrets live in the project's per-app .env.local files (see the starter's .env.example) and are separate from MCP auth. The plugin uses no vendor CLI: these servers are how it reaches each service.
